<h2 id="a)-Modified-Gompertz-biogas-production-(Yang-et-al.-2016)">a) Modified Gompertz biogas production (Yang et al. 2016)<a class="anchor-link" href="#a)-Modified-Gompertz-biogas-production-(Yang-et-al.-2016)">¶</a></h2><p>Cumulative production $H(t)$ (modified Gompertz):</p>
<p>$$ H(t) = P \times \exp\!\left(-\exp\Big(\frac{R_m e}{P}(\lambda - t) + 1\Big)\right)$$</p>
<p>with $P$: ultimate yield, $R_m$: max production rate parameter, $\lambda$: lag phase (days). Pedagogical parameters: $P=350$ mL/gVS, $R_m=25$ mL/gVS/d, $\lambda=2.5$ d — curve shown for $t \in [0, 30]$ d.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">math</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">gompertz</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">P</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Rm</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lambda_</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">inner</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Rm</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">e</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">P</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lambda_</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">t</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">P</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">inner</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered">
<div class="output_wrapper">
<div class="output">
<div class="output_area">
<div class="output_png output_subarea">
<img alt="No description has been provided for this image" src="data:image/png;base64,"/>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="b)-First-order-kinetics-(Chen-et-al.-2016)">b) First-order kinetics (Chen et al. 2016)<a class="anchor-link" href="#b)-First-order-kinetics-(Chen-et-al.-2016)">¶</a></h2><p>$$ B(t) = B_{\\max}\bigl(1 - e^{-kt}\bigr) $$</p>
<p>Parameters: $B_{\\max}=320$ mL/gVS, $k=0.08$ d⁻¹.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">first_order</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">B_max</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">k</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">B_max</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">k</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">t</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="c)-Monod-growth-(Rojas-Sossa-et-al.-2017)">c) Monod growth (Rojas-Sossa et al. 2017)<a class="anchor-link" href="#c)-Monod-growth-(Rojas-Sossa-et-al.-2017)">¶</a></h2><p>$$ \mu = \mu_{\\max}\, \frac{S}{K_s + S} $$</p>
<p>Scan $S \in [0, 5000]$ mg/L with $\mu_{\\max}=0.35$ d⁻¹, $K_s=500$ mg/L.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">monod</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">S</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">mu_max</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Ks</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">mu_max</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">S</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Ks</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">S</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="d)-Haldane-inhibition-(Rojas-Sossa-et-al.-2019)">d) Haldane inhibition (Rojas-Sossa et al. 2019)<a class="anchor-link" href="#d)-Haldane-inhibition-(Rojas-Sossa-et-al.-2019)">¶</a></h2><p>$$ \mu = \mu_{\\max}\, \frac{S}{K_s + S + S^2/K_i} $$</p>
<p>Parameters: $\mu_{\\max}=0.35$, $K_s=500$, $K_i=3000$ mg/L — exhibits a <strong>substrate inhibition peak</strong> at finite $S$.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">haldane</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">S</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">mu_max</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Ks</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Ki</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">mu_max</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">S</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Ks</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">S</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">S</span><span class="o">**</span><span class="mi">2</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">Ki</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="e)-Diversity-indices-for-anaerobic-communities-(Zhong-et-al.-2016)">e) Diversity indices for anaerobic communities (Zhong et al. 2016)<a class="anchor-link" href="#e)-Diversity-indices-for-anaerobic-communities-(Zhong-et-al.-2016)">¶</a></h2><p><strong>Shannon</strong>: $H' = - \sum_i p_i \ln p_i$. <strong>Simpson</strong>: $D = 1 - \sum_i p_i^2$.</p>
<p>Synthetic <strong>relative-abundance style</strong> OTU/read counts illustrate three digester regimes: startup (uneven pioneers), stable ( richer, more balanced ), inhibited (dominance collapse of diversity).</p>
</div>
